name: aria-live
description: Co-host your Twitch build stream: read what chat proposes and votes for, or build the approved task as the coding agent.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your Aria Live Studio server, where Twitch viewers propose features with !idea, vote with !vote, and a coding agent builds the winner after you approve it on the dashboard.

Choose a role:

- **cohost** (default): read-only. Summarise what chat wants, frame the vote, draft recaps and social posts.
- **streamer**: co-host tools plus round controls (open a round, start or close the vote). Approving, running and cancelling builds stay on the dashboard.
- **agent**: the five coding-agent tools (wait for the approved task, claim it, report progress, complete it).

Copy the key or token from the dashboard: Connect a coding agent → Remote (URL). This bundle is a small local proxy to the server's remote MCP endpoint; it adds no tools or permissions of its own. Viewer text is always marked as untrusted input.

aria_live_url.title: Aria Live URL
aria_live_url.description: Address of your Aria Live server (PUBLIC_URL), for example http://localhost:3000 or your tunnel URL. You can also paste the full co-host or streamer URL from the dashboard here and leave the key empty.

role.title: Role: cohost, streamer or agent
role.description: cohost = read-only co-host tools; streamer = co-host tools plus round controls; agent = coding-agent tools (claim, progress, complete). Type one of the three words.

access_key.title: Co-host or streamer key
access_key.description: For the cohost or streamer role: the last part of the co-host or streamer URL on the dashboard (…/mcp/cohost/<key>). Leave empty for the agent role.

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: For the agent role only: the agent token from the dashboard (Connect a coding agent). Leave empty for cohost and streamer.
